Define a Stage in a Multi-Stage SLURM Pipeline DAG

Source: R/pipeline.R
slurm_stage.Rd

Declares one executable node of a dependent HPC workflow assembled with slurm_pipeline() and executed with slurm_pipeline_run(). Upstream stage outputs are passed into downstream stages either via args_from_upstream (a function mapping the named list of upstream results to a new args_list) or automatically as a single fan-in task fun(upstream_results) when both args_list and args_from_upstream are NULL.

Usage

slurm_stage(
  name,
  fun,
  args_list = NULL,
  args_from_upstream = NULL,
  depends_on = character(),
  resources = NULL,
  packages = character(),
  globals = list(),
  seed = NULL,
  container_sif = NULL,
  container_binds = character(),
  modules = character(),
  env_vars = list(),
  dependency_type = c("afterok", "afterany", "afternotok"),
  simplify_upstream = TRUE
)

Arguments

name

Unique stage identifier (letters, digits, _, -).

fun

Worker function fun(arg) executed for each task in this stage.

args_list

Optional list (or vector coercible to list) of task inputs for this stage. Required for root stages (stages with empty depends_on).

args_from_upstream

Optional function function(upstream_results) returning an args_list built dynamically from collected upstream stage outputs (named by upstream stage name).

depends_on

Character vector of upstream stage names that must finish before this stage runs. Default character().

resources

Optional slurmpilot_resources object (from resource_spec() or estimate_resources()). If NULL, a sensible default spec is constructed automatically at runtime from length(stage_args).

packages

Character vector of worker packages to attach.

globals

Named list of helper objects/functions bound to fun.

seed

Optional integer base seed for independent L'Ecuyer-CMRG parallel RNG streams.

container_sif

Optional path to Apptainer .sif image.

container_binds

Optional character vector of Apptainer --bind mounts.

modules

Optional character vector of HPC modules to load.

env_vars

Optional named list/vector of extra environment variables.

dependency_type

SLURM dependency condition: "afterok" (default), "afterany", or "afternotok".

simplify_upstream

Logical; passed to slurm_collect() when collecting upstream stage results for this stage. Default TRUE.

Value

An S3 object of class "slurmpilot_stage".

See also

slurm_pipeline(), slurm_pipeline_run(), slurm_pipeline_status(), slurm_pipeline_collect()

Examples

s1 <- slurm_stage("simulate", fun = function(x) x^2, args_list = as.list(1:4))
s2 <- slurm_stage("summarize", fun = function(up) sum(up$simulate), depends_on = "simulate")
print(s1)
#> <<slurmpilot_stage>> "simulate" | tasks=4 | deps=none (root)
